mechanism: Codeine metabolism via CYP2D6 may be affected by levonorgestrel's hepatic enzyme modulation, and codeine's CNS depression may be enhanced by progestin effects; additionally, opioids may reduce GI motility affecting levonorgestrel absorption.
action: Monitor for reduced contraceptive efficacy and increased opioid side effects; counsel on backup contraception during codeine use and report any breakthrough bleeding.
